name: Remove retention policy assignment
description: Remove retention policy assignment Removes a retention policy assignment applied to content. DELETE /2.0/retention_policy_assignments/{retention_policy_assignment_id}

name: Get retention policy assignment
description: Get retention policy assignment Retrieves a retention policy assignment. GET /2.0/retention_policy_assignments/{retention_policy_assignment_id}
context:
GET /2.0/retention_policy_assignments/{retention_policy_assignment_id}
Retrieves a retention policy assignment.
Required: retention_policy_assignment_id (path) — The ID of the retention policy assignment.
Optional: fields (query) — A comma-separated list of attributes to include in the response. This can be used to request fields that are not normally returned in a standard response. Be aware that specifying this parameter will have the effect that none of the standard fields are returned in the response unless explicitly specified, instead only fields for the mini representation are returned, additional to the fields requested.

Returns a list of file versions under retention for a retention policy assignment.
